To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
primordial magnetic fields are expected to have non-Gaussian statistics and that these can be detected in the CMB, provided the magnetic fields are coherent on the horizon scale.

i) the intrinsic statistics of a magnetic field are non-Gaussian; ii) the statistics of a coherent primordial magnetic field are non- Gaussian; and, iii) the non-Gaussianities of the CMB are not a consequence of the non- Gaussianities of the magnetic field.

(i) the power spectrum of the magnetic field can be calculated analytically for the simplest models; (ii) the power spectrum can be calculated numerically for more general models; (iii) the statistics of the magnetic field are non-Gaussian; (iv) the statistics of a coherent magnetic field are imprinted in a simple way on the CMB; (v) the statistics of incoherent fields are not imprinted on the CMB
